Class IntellijHints

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.ToolContext
uno.anahata.asi.agi.tool.AnahataToolkit
uno.anahata.asi.ide.tools.hints.AbstractHints
uno.anahata.asi.intellij.tools.java.IntellijHints
All Implemented Interfaces:
ContextProvider, PropertyChangeSource, Rebindable
public class IntellijHints extends AbstractHints
Surfaces IntelliJ's on-the-fly analysis (inspections + annotators) for a file.

This is the IntelliJ counterpart of the NetBeans Hints toolkit. Where NetBeans drives its hints SPI, IntelliJ runs the code-analysis daemon's main passes on demand via DaemonCodeAnalyzerImpl.runMainPasses(PsiFile, Document, ProgressIndicator) and reports the resulting HighlightInfos (errors, warnings, weak warnings) with line numbers, messages, and available quick-fix action names wrapped in IntellijHintInfo.

    • applyHint

      public String applyHint(String filePath, int line, String fixName) throws AgiToolException
      Applies a quick-fix to a highlight on a given line of a file.

      Re-runs the analysis daemon, locates a highlight on the target line whose registered quick-fix matches (by name substring, or the first fix), opens the file at that offset, and invokes the fix's IntentionAction inside a write command.

      Parameters:
      filePath - the absolute path of the file.
      line - the 1-based line number of the highlight to fix.
      fixName - a case-insensitive substring of the fix name, or null for the first fix.
      Returns:
      a confirmation naming the applied fix.
      Throws:
      AgiToolException - if the file, highlight, or a matching fix cannot be resolved.

    • runMainPasses

      private List<com.intellij.codeInsight.daemon.impl.HighlightInfo> runMainPasses(com.intellij.openapi.project.Project project, com.intellij.psi.PsiFile psiFile, com.intellij.openapi.editor.Document document)
      Runs the analysis daemon's main passes for a file synchronously and returns its highlights. Must be called off the EDT (AI tool threads qualify).
      Parameters:
      project - the host project.
      psiFile - the file to analyze.
      document - the file's document.
      Returns:
      the highlights produced by the main passes.
